canonical_claim.template: In 2025, American Financing Corporation denied {value} of its 11,062 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: American Financing Corporation decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: American Financing Corporation will deny any specific future application with 71.0% probability
American Financing Corporation is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
American Financing Corporation discriminates or violates law
71.0% applies to American Financing Corporation's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
